clusters.headline: Bank Of Korea Raises Key Interest Rate To 3.25 Percent Amid Boom
aiSummaryBullets: The Bank of Korea increased the key interest rate by 25 basis points to 3.25 percent to address persistent inflation.
Economic growth forecasts for 2027 were revised upward to 4.1 percent, driven by a surge in the semiconductor industry.

clusters.headline: Persib Bandung Prepares for AFC Champions League 2 Match vs FC Seoul
aiSummaryBullets: FC Seoul head coach Kim Gi-dong expressed anticipation regarding the atmosphere at Gelora Bandung Lautan Api stadium during the match.
Media reports suggest striker Mariano Peralta may appear in the lineup for the upcoming AFC Champions League 2 fixture.

clusters.headline: South Korean Democratic Party Seeks Impeachment Of Chief Justice
aiSummaryBullets: The Democratic Party aims to initiate an impeachment motion against the Supreme Court chief justice on December 3.
The planned action follows the Supreme Court's decision to order a retrial for former Prime Minister Han regarding his martial law role.

clusters.headline: Seoul Shares See Minor Rebound Following Steep AI Market Decline
aiSummaryBullets: The Korea Composite Stock Price Index rose by 0.29 percent to finish at 4,711.21 points on Thursday.
The minor market rebound follows a substantial six percent retreat recorded in the previous trading session.

clusters.headline: Hanwha Eagles Catcher Heo In-seo Voted 2026 KBO Top Rookie
aiSummaryBullets: Hanwha Eagles catcher Heo In-seo was officially named the KBO's top rookie for the 2026 season.
The award was announced during the Korea Baseball Organization's annual ceremony held on November 26.

clusters.headline: Kia Tigers Superstar Kim Do-yeong Claims Second KBO MVP Award
aiSummaryBullets: Kia Tigers player Kim Do-yeong has been named the Korea Baseball Organization Most Valuable Player.
This accolade marks the second time the professional athlete has received the prestigious league award.

clusters.headline: President Lee Jae Myung Addresses Domestic Policy and North Korea
aiSummaryBullets: President Lee Jae Myung urged a rapid increase in public housing supply to stabilize the local market.
The administration confirmed that North Korea will remain classified as an enemy in the upcoming defense white paper.

clusters.headline: Justice Minister Nominee Lee Yong-cheol Discusses System Reforms
aiSummaryBullets: Justice Minister nominee Lee Yong-cheol pledged to finalize ongoing reforms within the nation's criminal justice system.
The nominee stated that investigative independence must remain aligned with public expectations and accountability.

clusters.headline: South Korea Imposes Stricter Penalties Following AI Exam Scandal
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Han Seong-sook ordered a comprehensive investigation into reports of cheating on state-administered examinations.
Proposed measures include distributing 8,000 metal detectors and implementing 10-year bans for students caught using AI-assisted technology.

clusters.headline: Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il Addresses Volatile South Korea Market
aiSummaryBullets: Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il stated that the government has prepared contingency measures beyond existing stock market stabilization funds.
The KOSPI index experienced a five percent decline, prompting government intervention to address market instability.

clusters.headline: President Lee Jae Myung Expands Scope Of South Korea Cheonghae Unit
aiSummaryBullets: President Lee Jae Myung announced an expanded operational mandate for the Cheonghae naval unit to ensure maritime safety.
The National Assembly's defense committee approved a motion to shift the unit from Somali waters toward the Arabian region.

clusters.headline: K-Pop Groups BIGBANG And Kiss Of Life Announce New Music Releases
aiSummaryBullets: The K-pop boy group BIGBANG officially released their new digital single titled GiiiRIP.
Girl group Kiss of Life unveiled teaser photos for their first winter-themed single, Greedy.

clusters.headline: KEPCO Confirms Large Data Breach Affecting 1.52 Million Customers
aiSummaryBullets: State-run utility provider KEPCO identified a data security breach impacting approximately 1.52 million individuals.
The compromised data includes users from the company's electronic procurement system and the KEPCO ON customer service platform.

clusters.headline: NPA Commissioner General Kim Jong-Chul Vows To Earn Public Trust
aiSummaryBullets: Kim Jong-chul assumed the role of Commissioner General for the National Police Agency.
The appointment follows recent legal reforms that removed investigative powers from prosecutors.

clusters.headline: Nvidia Maintains GPU Supply Commitments To South Korea Post-Huang
aiSummaryBullets: Nvidia has maintained its commitment to supply South Korea with graphics processing units.
The assurance follows the resignation of Nvidia Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang.

clusters.headline: South Korean Fair Trade Watchdog Fines 15 Firms For Bond Collusion
aiSummaryBullets: Fifteen bond dealers have been penalized 1.6 trillion won for colluding on government bond bidding processes.
The decision was issued by the South Korean Fair Trade Commission following an investigation into market rigging practices.

clusters.headline: Singer Mark From NCT Announces Upcoming Solo Studio Album Windmill
aiSummaryBullets: The former NCT member Mark will release his new studio album titled Windmill next month.
The upcoming album includes the lead single What’s Your Dream? Don’t Have One and previously released B-sides.
